title: SCA Minhag of the Week 301: "The Final Meal Before the Fast of the 9th of Ab"

chapters.title: One Cooked Dish and Customs for the Final Meal
chapters.about: Tisha B'Av on Tuesday or Thursday, Aleppo customs, Shulchan Aruch, and Rambam in Mishneh Torah.

chapters.title: The Ashkenazic Custom and Objections
chapters.about: Eating a larger meal before Mincha, Maharam, Rabbi Shlomo Luria in Poland, and Kaf HaChaim Sofer.

chapters.title: Sephardic Custom and Additional Foods
chapters.about: Sephardic practice, quantity of the cooked dish, bread, crackers, fruits, and vegetables.

chapters.title: Bayit Chadash and Timing the Larger Meal
chapters.about: Bayit Chadash from Poland, timing before halachic midday, and our custom.

summary: This class discusses the laws and customs of the final meal before the fast of Tisha B'Av, including the rule regarding one cooked dish when the fast falls on a Tuesday or Thursday. It covers opinions and practices recorded by Rabbi Shlomo Laniado, Maran in Shulchan Aruch, Rambam in Mishneh Torah, Maharam, Rabbi Shlomo Luria, Kaf HaChaim Sofer, and Bayit Chadash.
questions: What is the rule about cooked dishes for the final meal before Tisha B'Av when it falls on a Tuesday or Thursday?
What did people in Aleppo eat for their final meal before Tisha B'Av?
How did Rambam describe the practice of the pious and wise people regarding the final meal?
What was the Ashkenazic custom regarding a larger meal before Mincha and how did authorities view it?
What foods can be eaten in addition to the one cooked dish during the final meal?
